reasons.record_complete: Record omits batching detail, backup is unverified, rollback untested, load test not run, and the window collides with a marketing sale event.
reasons.change_decision: Genuine conflict between a conditional DB approval, unverified backup, and an approval-time calendar collision makes escalation or batched re-approval most likely.
reasons.change_risk: Large non-null backfill on 80M rows with unverified backup, untested rollback, and a peak-traffic sale overlap points to moderately high risk.
